mechanism.binding: a support/contradiction must bind same subject,object,time and action/result role;no association from filename or co-occurrence alone
mechanism.candidate_residual: arithmetic mean across fixed necessary conditions;unknown contributes0,not counterevidence;empty condition list=>residual0

mechanism.coverage: score all216;not merely rerank originalTop10;new condition text may not add information beyond shared public knowledge
